card.name: Comma after 'if such occurs' clauses
card.fires_on: The comma closing an 'If ... occurs/develops' condition clause in label instructions, just before the action to take. Also the word 'with' in 'may increase with duration of use'.

modes.label: Comma after if-clause
modes.description: Comma ending a conditional clause like 'If such contact occurs' or 'If irritation develops', before the instruction.
modes.example: Avoid direct contact of the skin or mucous membranes with ganciclovir solution. If such contact occurs<<,>> wash thoroughly with soap and

modes.label: 'increase with' duration
modes.description: The word 'with' after 'may increase' in the NSAID cardiovascular risk warning.
modes.example: This risk may occur early in treatment and may increase<< with>> duration of use [see Warnings and

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about influence or effect, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires at the comma after 'if this happens' in label warnings, and at 'with' in 'may increase with duration of use'.
